title: Create a feature library that follows the workspace conventions
description: Generates libs/<scope>/<server|web>/feature-<name> with the scope, platform and type tags the module-boundary rules expect.

name.description: Feature name without the 'feature-' prefix, e.g. 'users'.

scope.description: Product scope the library belongs to, e.g. 'core'.
scope.x-prompt: Which scope does this feature belong to?

platform.description: Runtime side: node libraries live under server/, web libraries under web/.
platform.x-prompt: Which platform does this feature run on?
